blocks.en: Introduction and Definitions

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解 COVID-19 疫情如何加速遠端稽查 (Remote Inspection) 工具的採用，以及其對製藥合規監管的長遠意義
blocks.en: Understand how the COVID-19 pandemic accelerated the adoption of remote inspection tools, and what this means over the long term for pharmaceutical regulatory compliance

blocks.zh: 能夠區分三種遠端稽查形式：桌面稽查 (Desktop Inspection)、虛擬稽查 (Virtual Inspection) 與混合稽查 (Hybrid Inspection) 的核心差異
blocks.en: Be able to distinguish the core differences among the three forms of remote inspection: Desktop Inspection, Virtual Inspection and Hybrid Inspection

blocks.zh: 明確掌握本文件的適用範圍：僅限 GMP/GDP 法規稽查，不涵蓋供應商稽核或內部稽查
blocks.en: Be clear on the scope of this document: it covers GMP/GDP regulatory inspections only, not supplier audits or internal audits

blocks.zh: 理解關鍵技術術語的精確定義，包括文件分享平台 (Document-Sharing Platform) 與視訊通訊平台 (Video Communication Platform)
blocks.en: Understand the precise definitions of key technical terms, including Document-Sharing Platform and Video Communication Platform

blocks.zh: 認識本文件的定位：屬於實務建議，並非法規標準或指引
blocks.en: Recognize the status of this document: it offers practical considerations and is neither a regulatory standard nor a guideline

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：三種遠端稽查類型的光譜 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts: The Spectrum of Three Remote Inspection Types

blocks.zh: 本文件定義的三種遠端稽查形式，可視為一個複雜度由低至高的連續光譜：
blocks.en: The three forms of remote inspection defined in this document can be viewed as a continuous spectrum of increasing complexity:

blocks.zh: Desktop Inspection（桌面稽查）：純文件審閱，書面問答，無實地接觸。複雜度最低，準備工作以書面資料為主。
blocks.en: Desktop Inspection: Document review only, with written questions and answers and no physical contact. This is the least complex form, and preparation centers on written materials.

blocks.zh: Virtual Inspection（虛擬稽查）：桌面稽查 + 即時視訊串流、螢幕分享或虛擬廠區導覽。稽查員「眼睛進得去，身體進不去」。
blocks.en: Virtual Inspection: Desktop inspection plus live video streaming, screen sharing or a virtual site tour. The inspector can "see in but cannot step in".

blocks.zh: Hybrid Inspection（混合稽查）：部分遠端 + 部分現場到訪。靈活組合，可同步或分階段執行，並可出具單一或分開的稽查報告。
blocks.en: Hybrid Inspection: Part remote and part on-site visit. The two can be combined flexibly, run concurrently or in phases, and may result in a single report or separate reports.

blocks.zh: 理解這個光譜非常重要：稽查形式決定了你的準備策略、人員部署與技術基礎設施投入的等級。
blocks.en: Understanding this spectrum is very important: the inspection format determines your preparation strategy, staff deployment and the level of investment in technical infrastructure.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 遠端稽查就像視訊看診 vs. 親自到診所的選擇：
blocks.en: Remote inspection is like choosing between a video consultation and an in-person clinic visit:

blocks.zh: 桌面稽查 = 先傳病歷和檢驗報告給醫生，醫生書面回覆問題——醫生完全沒見到你本人。
blocks.en: Desktop inspection = You send your medical records and test reports to the doctor, who replies to questions in writing. The doctor never sees you in person.

blocks.zh: 虛擬稽查 = 視訊看診，醫生透過鏡頭看你的喉嚨、聽你描述症狀——比書面更多資訊，但仍無法觸診。
blocks.en: Virtual inspection = A video consultation. The doctor looks at your throat through the camera and listens to you describe your symptoms. This gives more information than writing alone, but the doctor still cannot examine you by touch.

blocks.zh: 混合稽查 = 先視訊初診，確認需要後再到診所做精密檢查——兩者互補。
blocks.en: Hybrid inspection = A video first consultation, followed by a clinic visit for detailed tests once the need is confirmed. The two approaches complement each other.

blocks.zh: 到廠稽查 = 親赴診所，最全面，但也最耗時、耗資源。
blocks.en: On-site inspection = Going to the clinic in person. This is the most comprehensive, but also the most time-consuming and resource-intensive.

blocks.zh: 重點：目標相同（評估合規性 / 診斷病況），但工具和資訊深度不同。同樣地，遠端稽查不是放棄合規標準，而是用不同工具達到同等目的。
blocks.en: Key point: The goal is the same (assessing compliance / diagnosing the condition), but the tools and depth of information differ. Likewise, remote inspection does not lower compliance standards; it uses different tools to achieve the same purpose.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：本文件的關鍵限制 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes: Key Limitation of This Document

blocks.zh: 請特別注意文件中的這句話：「This document does not represent a standard or regulatory guidance.」
blocks.en: Pay particular attention to this sentence in the document: "This document does not represent a standard or regulatory guidance."

blocks.zh: 這意味著：
blocks.en: This means:

blocks.zh: 本文件屬於 Points to Consider（值得考慮的觀點），是 PDA 的最佳實務建議，並非法規要求。
blocks.en: This document is a set of Points to Consider. It reflects PDA best practice recommendations and is not a regulatory requirement.

blocks.zh: 各國衛生主管機關仍依其本國法律框架行事；本文件的建議不能取代當地法規要求。
blocks.en: Health authorities in each country still act within their own legal frameworks; the recommendations in this document cannot replace local regulatory requirements.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在面對不同主管機關（FDA、EMA、PMDA、TFDA等）的遠端稽查時，須以各主管機關的具體要求為準，再參考本文件的建議加以補充。
blocks.en: When a CDMO faces remote inspections by different authorities (FDA, EMA, PMDA, TFDA, etc.), the specific requirements of each authority take precedence, and the recommendations in this document should be used to supplement them.

blocks.en: Why is thorough planning more critical for remote inspections than for on-site inspections?

blocks.en: Scope

blocks.zh: 重點提示：GxP 的延伸應用 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes: Extended Application to Other GxP Areas

blocks.zh: 文件明確說明可「非正式地」延伸至其他 GxP 稽查，但有前提：
blocks.en: The document states that it may be extended "informally" to other GxP inspections, with the following caveats:

blocks.zh: 文件開發時並未特別考量 GLP（良好實驗室規範）或 GCP（良好臨床試驗規範）的特定需求。
blocks.en: The document was not developed with the specific needs of GLP (Good Laboratory Practice) or GCP (Good Clinical Practice) in particular in mind.

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 同時承接藥理試驗或臨床試驗相關服務，應謹慎評估本文件建議是否完全適用於那些場域的遠端稽查。
blocks.en: If a CDMO also provides pharmacology study or clinical trial related services, it should carefully assess whether the recommendations in this document are fully applicable to remote inspections in those settings.

blocks.zh: 對於供應商稽核（Supplier Audit），雖然文件不適用，但「類似挑戰」的提法意味著本文件仍可作為很好的準備參考框架。
blocks.en: Supplier audits are outside the scope of the document, but its reference to "similar challenges" means it can still serve as a useful framework for preparation.

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 正接受 FDA 對 API 製造的 GMP 稽查（遠端形式），本文件是否適用？若是一家委外分析實驗室接受 GLP 稽查呢？
blocks.en: If your CDMO is undergoing a remote FDA GMP inspection of API manufacturing, does this document apply? What about an outsourced analytical laboratory undergoing a GLP inspection?

blocks.zh: 遠端供應商稽核與遠端 GMP 稽查在「類似挑戰」上有哪些共同點？
blocks.en: What do remote supplier audits and remote GMP inspections have in common in terms of "similar challenges"?

blocks.en: Key Concepts: Scope Boundaries of This Document

blocks.zh: 本節清楚劃定了文件的「適用」與「不適用」邊界，理解這個邊界非常重要：
blocks.en: This section clearly draws the line between what is and is not within the scope of the document, and understanding this boundary is very important:

blocks.zh: Glossary — 詞彙定義
blocks.en: Glossary

blocks.zh: 重點提示：術語差異——Virtual = Distant Assessment = Remote Interactive Evaluation
blocks.en: Key Notes: Terminology Differences: Virtual = Distant Assessment = Remote Interactive Evaluation

blocks.zh: 文件特別指出，全球稽查機關使用的術語存在差異，這對實務應用非常重要：
blocks.en: The document points out that the terminology used by inspectorates around the world varies, which matters a great deal in practice:

blocks.zh: Virtual Inspection：PDA 本文件使用的標準術語，強調即時通訊技術的運用。
blocks.en: Virtual Inspection: The standard term used in this PDA document, emphasizing the use of real-time communication technology.

blocks.zh: Distant Assessment：某些主管機關（如英國 MHRA）偏好使用此詞，強調「距離上的評估」。
blocks.en: Distant Assessment: A term preferred by some authorities (such as the UK MHRA), emphasizing assessment carried out at a distance.

blocks.zh: Remote Interactive Evaluation：另一種表述，強調「互動性」，與 Desktop 的單向書面問答形成對比。
blocks.en: Remote Interactive Evaluation: Another expression, emphasizing "interactivity", in contrast to the one-way written questions and answers of a Desktop inspection.

blocks.zh: 實務建議：在收到主管機關稽查通知時，務必確認對方使用的術語所對應的實際稽查形式，避免依據錯誤的假設進行準備。例如，某 EU 國家主管機關說「Distant Assessment」，你必須確認這是否等同於本文件的 Virtual Inspection（需要視訊設備），還是僅限於桌面文件審閱。
blocks.en: Practical advice: When you receive an inspection notice from an authority, always confirm which actual inspection format the term they use refers to, so that you do not prepare on a wrong assumption. For example, if an authority in an EU country says "Distant Assessment", you must confirm whether this is equivalent to a Virtual Inspection as defined in this document (which requires video equipment) or is limited to a desktop document review.

blocks.zh: Desktop Inspection 的「啟動信號」是什麼？這對 CDMO 有什麼實務意涵？（提示：文件請求到達的那一刻，稽查已開始。）
blocks.en: What is the "trigger" for a Desktop Inspection? What does it mean in practice for a CDMO? (Hint: the inspection has begun the moment the document request arrives.)

blocks.zh: Document-Sharing Platform 必須是「安全的（secure）」——這在實務上意味著哪些技術要求？（考慮：存取控制、稽核軌跡、資料加密）
blocks.en: The Document-Sharing Platform must be "secure". What technical requirements does this imply in practice? (Consider access control, audit trail and data encryption.)

blocks.zh: 如果一家主管機關說要進行「Remote Interactive Evaluation」，你的第一個確認動作是什麼？
blocks.en: If an authority says it will conduct a "Remote Interactive Evaluation", what is your first step to confirm?

blocks.zh: Hybrid Inspection 可以出具「分開的報告（separate reports）」——這對 CDMO 的 CAPA 管理有什麼複雜性？
blocks.en: A Hybrid Inspection can result in "separate reports". What complications does this create for a CDMO's CAPA management?

blocks.en: The table below consolidates the key characteristics of all the inspection types in this chapter. It is the best tool for quick recall and exam preparation:

blocks.en: Note: Remote Inspection is the umbrella term covering Desktop, Virtual and Hybrid; On-site is not a subtype of Remote.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 稽查動員策略 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application: CDMO Inspection Mobilization Strategy

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，收到不同類型的遠端稽查通知時，應採取不同程度的動員策略：
blocks.en: As a CDMO, you should adopt a different level of mobilization depending on the type of remote inspection notice you receive:

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：稽查形式的確認越早越好。一旦確認為 Virtual 或 Hybrid，立即啟動跨部門稽查準備委員會（Inspection Readiness Committee），並按本文件後續章節的建議逐步推進。
blocks.en: Key principle: the sooner the inspection format is confirmed, the better. Once it is confirmed as Virtual or Hybrid, immediately activate a cross-functional Inspection Readiness Committee and proceed step by step according to the recommendations in the later sections of this document.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: COVID-19 的催化作用：疫情加速了遠端稽查工具的採用，但到廠稽查仍被視為合規評估的最佳方式；遠端工具是「有意義的補充」，而非等量替代。
blocks.en: The catalytic effect of COVID-19: The pandemic accelerated the adoption of remote inspection tools, but on-site inspection is still regarded as the best way to assess compliance; remote tools are a "meaningful supplement" and not an equivalent replacement.

blocks.zh: 三種遠端稽查類型：Desktop（純文件書面）→ Virtual（文件 + 即時視訊）→ Hybrid（遠端 + 現場部分到訪），複雜度與準備需求依序遞增。
blocks.en: Three types of remote inspection: Desktop (documents and written exchange only) → Virtual (documents plus live video) → Hybrid (remote plus partial on-site visit). Complexity and preparation needs increase in that order.

blocks.zh: 範圍限定：本文件僅適用於 GMP/GDP 法規稽查，不適用於供應商稽核、內部稽查或自查；其他 GxP 稽查可非正式參考。
blocks.en: Defined scope: This document applies only to GMP/GDP regulatory inspections. It does not apply to supplier audits, internal audits or self-inspections; other GxP inspections may use it as an informal reference.

blocks.zh: 術語一致性警示：全球稽查機關術語不統一——Virtual Inspection = Distant Assessment = Remote Interactive Evaluation；收到通知時務必確認對方所指的稽查形式。
blocks.en: Terminology consistency warning: Terminology is not uniform across inspectorates worldwide: Virtual Inspection = Distant Assessment = Remote Interactive Evaluation. When you receive a notice, always confirm which inspection format the authority means.

blocks.zh: 文件定位：本文件為 PDA Points to Consider，屬於最佳實務建議，非法規標準；需以當地法律法規要求為最終依據。
blocks.en: Document status: This document is a PDA Points to Consider and is a best practice recommendation, not a regulatory standard; local laws and regulatory requirements remain the final basis.

blocks.zh: CDMO 動員策略：Desktop 稽查以文件團隊為主；Virtual 稽查需全廠核心團隊含 IT 和視訊設備待命；Hybrid 稽查需最高等級全廠動員，整合遠端與現場準備。
blocks.en: CDMO mobilization strategy: Desktop inspections are led by the documentation team; Virtual inspections need the core site-wide team on standby, including IT and video equipment; Hybrid inspections need the highest level of site-wide mobilization, integrating remote and on-site preparation.
